can: Passar do B1 para o B1+.

lessons.title: Teste de passagem
lessons.goal: Passar do B1 para o B1+.

test.prompt: She ___ (buy) a new car last month.
A very strong word for “hungry” is ___.
How can I go to the airport?
acc: How can I get to the airport
How do I get to the airport

test.prompt: She is ___ engineer. (a / an / the / sem artigo)
Hold ___, please. I'll put you through.
When I was a child, I ___ climb trees.
When we arrived, the game ___ (already / start).
I ___ (play) football every day when I was young.

test.instr: Transforme em pergunta indireta, começando com "Could you tell me...?": "Where is the station?"
acc: tell me where the station is
test.show: Could you tell me where the station is?

chat.scenario: Entrevista informal para um programa de intercâmbio.
chat.role: Entrevistador do programa, que pergunta sobre rotina, planos, experiências, histórias do passado e como você era antes.
chat.goal: Usar pelo menos 6 destas estruturas corretamente: present simple e continuous, futuro, present perfect, past simple e continuous, used to, have to ou should, comparativo; e fazer 1 pergunta indireta no fim.
chat.turns: 12 a 15 trocas; a IA dá a nota no relatório final e 7 ou mais aprova

en.gram: B1 passage test: mixed review of units 1 to 10. Grammar: present simple and continuous, future forms, present perfect and past simple, past simple and continuous, used to / would, have to / must / should, comparatives and superlatives, indirect questions.
en.vocab: Mixed vocabulary from units 1 to 10 (food, family and personality, money, transport, rules, abilities, sport, relationships).
en.scenario: An informal interview for a student exchange program.
en.role: The interviewer of the program. Ask about daily routine, plans, past experiences, stories from the past and how the student was before (used to). Near the end, the student should ask you one indirect question.
en.goal: The student uses at least 6 of these structures correctly: present simple and continuous, a future form, present perfect, past simple and continuous, used to, have to or should, a comparative; and asks 1 indirect question at the end.
